rationale: The stock is trading at the extreme top of its intraday range (93.3%) after a significant gap-down, indicating that the initial selling pressure has been fully absorbed and the price is stalling near resistance. Entering long here offers a poor risk-reward profile due to the proximity to the session high and the lack of fresh volume to confirm a breakout, while shorting against a strong momentum reversal into the highs is mechanically unfavorable.
